svg.title: GP-MSRM response-filtered covariance and observation covariance
svg.text: Integrate the latent process before fitting feature maps and response parameters
hₘ on rows; h_q on columns
κₘq(t,t′) = ∬ hₘ(u) h_q(v) cℓ(t−u, t′−v) du dv
